logs.description: Wrote an email to my chef de projet to ask about how to tackle the rest of the project, since I didn't complete the features planned for sprint 2.

Discussed with Sahli. B about the state of the projet:
He said that I can be agile and continue the unfinished tasks from sprint 2 during sprint 3 so that the core CRUD is working. The search and filtering tasks orginally planned for sprint 3 are minor features compared to the CRUD so if they aren't done because of time then it's okay.
Wrote tests for create recipe feat (unit & api); view recipe feat (unit & api); authenticate/authorise/validate/erroHandler middleware (unit); jwt/password helpers (unit)
